facts.business: Filtron Engineers Limited operates a legacy process and plant equipment business for dairy, food, and beverage industries and, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Gabrielle Infra Speciality Private Limited, a construction and infrastructure business focused on general contracting, EPC, and PMC services.

guidance_or_targets.statement: FY 2026-27 to be the first year in which the construction and infrastructure business contributes for a full twelve-month period, providing a more representative picture of the enlarged group's earnings capacity.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Full-year contribution from construction and infrastructure business

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion on standalone financial statements due to inability to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence; balances in current assets and liabilities subject to confirmation and reconciliation; reliance on management representations for inventory realizable value, loans, investments, guarantees, deposits, related party transactions, and income tax returns filed on unaudited figures.

key_risks: Integration risk in aligning GISPL's operations, accounting systems, internal controls, and financial reporting within compressed timelines
Construction and infrastructure sector cyclicality and sensitivity to interest rates, input costs (steel, cement, labour), and pace of government capital expenditure
Working-capital intensive construction business; delays in client approvals/payments, cost overruns, or project delays can adversely affect margins and cash flows
facts.related_party_note: Auditor relied upon management representation in respect of related party transactions.
